profile.headline: Senior Software engineer at Google
profile.summary:
Senior software engineer, with experience in AI infrastructure and tooling, privacy and user experience. Work experience as an engineering manager. Currently focused on AI agentic safety.

At Google, I work on agentic safty systems (to protect users), privacy preserving technology, and to develop pipelines to provide training data and evaluate AI models.  In the past, I led a team of engineers and researchers focused on Reinforcement Learning and Imitation Learning. I am a co-author of "Android in the Wild, a large scale dataset for device control" paper and dataset. I have worked on on-device AI models, including user feature design, as well as infrastructure to support those features as part of the Google Pixel lineup. I also have experience on developing UX for wearable devices on Google Glass and new interaction models for the Google Cast (Chromecast) platform focused on gaming. I led a team of Android engineers to launch a set of features on Google Maps and was the Android tech lead for Google Trusted Contacts. I worked on and launched the Game Manager APIs as part of Google Play Services 7.5 and was a Google I/O speaker in 2015.

I have experience working on agile teams and rapid prototyping environments. I have taught various courses on game programming and data structures as well as technical workshops on those topics.

I am deeply interested in game design and develop game prototypes as a hobby.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Google Research:
- Personal agent technology. 
- Model evaluation for automation systems. 
- Memory and orchestration systems for AI.
- On device machine intelligence and Reinforcement Learning.

Special projects (ML application research, AI -> UX)
Google Maps - Android Lead for feature teams.
Google Trusted Contacts - Lead Android Engineer.
Google[X] - Google Glass. UI/UX for wearables.
Chromecast - Software engineer. Interaction models focused on gaming. Launched the Game Manager APIs for Google Cast with Google Play Services 7.5 on Android, as well as the Chrome Sender and Receiver APIs.

Google I/O speaker in 2015.

positions.title: Software engineer
positions.description:
Gameplay software engineer (Client/Server), Bioware San Francisco (previously EA2D). Worked on Dragon Age Legends for Facebook and Google+. Responsible for the tutorial and quest systems in the game. Developed client and server game logic to deliver gameplay features and systems that require player state persistence on every step. Experience as live engineer and responding quickly to defects in a live game. Commitment to backward compatibility and long term development of the project. Constant work on improving performance and maintaining older parts of the codebase.

Worked on architecture design and implementation for an unannounced social game that is currently under development.

positions.title: Independent game developer
positions.description:
Indie game development in Adobe's Flash and Unity3d. Serious games designed to help children with attention disorder.

Blog and updates: http://www.silentkaken.com

positions.title: Senior game programmer
positions.description:
Development of game systems and design of game architecture using Emergent's Gamebryo game engine and Unity3d. 

Research of technologies, techniques and system design approaches for the team to use. Detect, document and communicate technical constraints and define rules and budgets to be followed by game developers.

Prototype of  both technical and gameplay features. Research alternative platforms and environments for game development.

Provided technical training in C++, physics simulation and Unity3d development to the rest of the team.

positions.title: Game programming and Software engineering teacher
positions.description:
Game development course planning, teaching C++, data structures,  Web application development, C#, DX Studio, Unity3d, etc.

Teacher of special courses on DX Studio & Unity3d.

positions.title: Gameplay programmer
positions.description:
Designed game architecture and prototyped games using Virtools, DXStudio and Unity3d game engines.

Notable project: In cooperation with Mexican and French professionals and students, we created web-based 3D adventure game for the French Embassy in Mexico, using the Unity game engine. In this particular project, I implemented a waypoint system and a set of tools to define character navigation in the scene.

projects.title: Android in the Wild
projects.description:
Android in the Wild (AitW) is a large-scale dataset for mobile device control that contains human-collected demonstrations of natural language instructions, user interface (UI) screens, and actions for a variety of human tasks.

Link to paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.10088
Link to the dataset: https://github.com/google-research/google-research/tree/master/android_in_the_wild

projects.title: Dragon Age Legends
projects.description: Free online RPG that brought the magic of BioWare's Dragon Age to Facebook and Google Plus, being a launch title for the latter.
